goal: Fail the IWYU static analysis CI task on compiler errors instead of silently passing
Ensure missing headers and broken analysis runs are caught immediately rather than ignored
agreement: Support because failing loudly is better than silently passing (maflcko)
Approach objection resolved by removing the masked exit code directly (maflcko)

why: P3 because it ensures CI jobs fail on fatal compilation errors rather than masking exit codes
Prevents uninspected build-step failures from going unnoticed during automated CI runs
